meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 可通过 WhatsApp 收发消息。它会用二维码或配对码认证手机,并区分专用号码与共享号码来设置行为。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道时触发。它会先询问使用专用还是共享号码,再引导二维码或配对码认证。

say.text: 帮我添加 WhatsApp 频道
say.note: 开始执行添加流程,先做号码安全检查。
选择二维码方式,在终端显示 QR 码供扫描。
选择配对码方式,在终端显示 8 位代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw gains a WhatsApp channel and can send/receive messages via WhatsApp. It authenticates via QR code or pairing code, and configures behavior differently for dedicated vs shared numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a WhatsApp channel for NanoClaw. It first runs a number safety check (dedicated vs shared), then guides QR or pairing-code authentication.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel for me
say_en.note: Starts the addition flow with the number safety check.

say_en.text: Connect WhatsApp with a QR code
say_en.note: Chooses QR mode and shows the scan code in the terminal.

say_en.text: Connect WhatsApp with a pairing code
say_en.note: Chooses pairing-code mode and shows the 8-character code.
